title: Year-end bookkeeping: 5 things to do before Dec 31
label: 1-minute bookkeeping fix

beats.sub: Jan. 31 is a Sunday, so it moves.

cta.sub: We'll DM you our cleanup page.

captions.instagram:
Five bookkeeping jobs to finish before the year closes:

✔️ Reconcile every account: bank, cards and loans.
✔️ Clear out 'uncategorized' transactions.
✔️ Collect W-9s from contractors now, not in late January.
✔️ Split out personal spending.
✔️ Save your December statements.

1099-NEC forms for 2026 payments go to contractors by Feb. 1, 2027 (Jan. 31 is a Sunday).

Behind? Start with the oldest month and work forward, or ask us about a cleanup.
